project: Project Cheeni — Batch 03: Defence & Damage Reactions

animations.gameplay_purpose: Experienced standing defensive block loop shielding face and upper chest.
animations.starting_pose: Balanced standing defensive guard raising forearms upward.
animations.ending_pose: Returns cleanly to ready standing defensive guard for seamless loop.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Entered from Standing Idle; exits cleanly to Standing Idle or Light/Heavy Hit if guard breaks.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Controlled low crouching defensive block loop protecting against low/mid strikes.
animations.starting_pose: Stable Batch 1 crouching stance bracing knees and torso.
animations.ending_pose: Returns cleanly to F1 crouching guard for seamless looping.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Entered from Batch 1 Crouch Idle; exits directly back to Crouch Idle.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Short, readable upper-body flinch when struck by a light attack from the right.
animations.starting_pose: Initial sharp wince and shoulder jolt with grounded feet.
animations.ending_pose: Quickly regains upright balance and returns toward standing fighting guard.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Triggered from Standing Idle/Guard; recovers directly into Standing Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Strong full-body recoil and stagger from a heavy strike while staying on his feet.
animations.starting_pose: Heavy chest/upper-body impact jolting guard open.
animations.ending_pose: Recovers from unsteady backward step into a composed standing guard.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Triggered from Standing Idle/Guard; recovers into Standing Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Involuntary airborne leftward launch from a launcher or heavy knockback attack.
animations.starting_pose: Heavy impact pitching torso backward as heels leave the ground.
animations.ending_pose: Back-first airborne descent posture ready to transition into Knockdown F1.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: F5 connects directly into Knockdown / Falling F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Complete airborne descent, ground impact absorption, and flat knocked-down state.
animations.starting_pose: Back-first airborne descent matching Launch / Knockback F5.
animations.ending_pose: Stable lying-down knocked-down pose (head LEFT, feet RIGHT) on ground baseline.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Entered from Launch / Knockback F5; F6 connects directly into Get-Up F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Believable elderly veteran recovery rising from knocked-down pose back to fighting guard.
animations.starting_pose: Knocked-down lying pose matching Knockdown F6, lifting head to recover.
animations.ending_pose: Balanced upright standing fighting guard facing RIGHT matching Batch 1 Idle F1.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Entered from Knockdown F6; F5 recovers directly into Standing Idle F1.

animations.gameplay_purpose: Shattered-guard dizzy stun reaction leaving Cheeni momentarily vulnerable while swaying.
animations.starting_pose: Guard violently forced open with arms flung wide and dazed expression.
animations.ending_pose: Unsteady open-guard swaying posture ready to loop during stun or recover to Idle.
animations.cross_batch_transition_notes: Triggered when guard meter breaks; exits into Standing Idle F1 or Hit Reaction if struck.
